title: Chapter 305 Lu Daosheng'S Decision
content:
Chapter 305 Lu Daosheng'S Decision

Facing the other two adults, even if they are not from the same clan, they should still be respectful.

Because the ancient battlefield is the common interests of the four tribes.

Now is not the time to have conflicts.

At this moment, besides the Xiao clan, the one who is most anxious is the Ye clan.

If the Xiao clan had not joined Xiao Luo and Lu Xue, the Ye clan would have suffered the most.

After all, their Ye tribe is not bad, and there are the most geniuses among the tribes entering the ancient battlefield.

If they all died in the ancient battlefield, for their Ye tribe, they would definitely hurt the major artery.

But at this time, their focus was not on the ancient battlefield, but outside the ancient battlefield.

As the surrounding space continues to tremble.

They knew that what was coming was coming soon.

At the same time, the ancient battlefield was also very lively.

A huge figure standing tall and earth has been walking deep in the battlefield since ancient times, and every step has caused the earth to tremble wildly.

It is such an existence that directly makes countless creatures entering the ancient battlefield feel desperate.

More importantly, this giant is really cruel.

Even the remaining forces in other ancient battlefields could only avoid them when they saw the giant.

It is conceivable how terrifying this giant is.

"Damn, why does this giant keep following us?!"

While running, Xiao Luo couldn't help but turn around and roar.

Lu Xue and Qin Feng also looked very bad.

This giant has been chasing them for a long time.

At first they just thought it was a giant walking aimlessly, and they didn't notice it until they kept changing directions.

No matter where they go, the giant follows.

What kind of deep hatred is there?

"I remembered it."

At this time, Lu Xue suddenly said.

"Sister Xue, what's going on?"

Xiao Luo asked hurriedly.

Lu Xue's expression was slightly condensed. She was not sure if it was, but now there is only one possibility.

"Do you still remember that I used the Xuanyuan Sword to cut the giant sword at the beginning?"

Hearing this, Xiao Luo and Qin Feng were stunned.

"You mean, just because you cut him, he kept chasing you?"

Xiao Luo couldn't believe it.

Lu Xue didn't say anything anymore, and this is the only possibility she could think of.

That giant sword was really petty, even more petty than her father.

"stop."

With a command, the three of them stopped directly.

"It's not a solution to keep running, it's time to make a break."

Looking at the giant slowly walking towards this side, Lu Xue said in a deep voice.

At this time, the giant's terrifying sense of oppression gradually came.

The gap is really too big.

"Sister Xue, why not think of another way."

"Yeah yeah."

Obviously, the two of them had no confidence in defeating this giant.

Hearing this, Lu Xue said confidently: "Don't worry, I have a sense of responsibility. You see, this giant is very strong, but in fact, he is just a strong man on the outside but the other side."

Strong outside and work on the middle?

Xiao Luo and Qin Feng looked at each other, both of whom were confused.

"Sister Xue, what do you mean?"

Lu Xue pointed at the giant and said, "Did you see the figure of the giant at the beginning? No, but only that giant sword."

"So I guess, this giant is just the former master projected by that giant sword."

"It's just a projection, and it doesn't have much strength. All I have to do is defeat that giant sword."

Hearing Lu Xue's confident words, Xiao Luo and the others pondered slightly, and suddenly felt that it seemed to make sense.

At this time, Lu Xue smiled disdainfully, "I held the Xuanyuan Sword and cut the giant sword into a gap. This sword is nothing more than that."

As he spoke, the fear in Lu Xue's heart disappeared from her almost fooling words.

I became cruel and even cheated myself.

"superior!"

Without hesitation, Lu Xue raised the Xuanyuan Sword and rushed directly towards the giant.

Xiao Luo and the other two of them didn't even react, but saw Lu Xue rushing to the giant.

At this time, when the giant saw Lu Xue rushing towards him, he did not hesitate at all. He raised his giant sword high and then slashed out with one sword.

laugh!

One sword, the sky opens!

The entire ancient battlefield sky was instantly split in half by this sword.

Space keeps raging.

Facing this extremely terrifying sword, Lu Xue's eyes were not even a trace of turmoil.

The Xuanyuan Sword in his hand was tightly held, and then he stabbed it out with a sword.

Buzz —

A dazzling light flashed out from the tip of Xuanyuan Sword.

The next moment, the two swords collided.

boom!

There was a loud bang.

Without any suspense, Lu Xue was directly stabbed into the earth with a sword.

boom!

Another loud noise, Lu Xue's entire body smashed into the ground, stirring up waves of dust and yellow sand filled the sky.

"Little Master!"

"Sister Xue!"

At this time, Lu Xue lost consciousness directly, and was covered in blood, lying flat in the pit.

It looks very tragic.

Seeing this, Ao Qing did not hesitate at all, and Tuoqi Lu Xue ran away directly.

Xiao Luo and Qin Feng followed closely behind.

This giant is so terrifying.

But at this moment, no one noticed that a ferocious crack appeared in the giant sword in the giant's hand, and at this time, the crack was still expanding.

As time goes by.

Click—

The giant sword broke from the middle of the sword body, and the entire giant phantom also dissipated with the wind.

In a vast sea of stars.

Lu Daosheng sat cross-legged here, looking calmly at the direction of the fairy world.

"Are you still worried?"

On the side, Yan Lingyun whispered softly.

Lu Daosheng smiled helplessly and said, "You can see it."

It was the first time that he had such strict requirements on Lu Xue.

In fact, with Lu Xue's current conditions, she can basically solve the difficulties in the fairy world.

But Lu Xue did not, she lacked blood.

The bloody nature that is tempered from countless battles of life and death.

Lu Daosheng is a snatcher, he doesn't, and of course, he doesn't need it either.

The only thing that exists is Yan Lingyun.

"You said, do I want to help you secretly?"

Lu Daosheng hesitated.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun closed her eyes directly, "It's up to you."

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng was silent.

After a while, Lu Daosheng suddenly thought of a good idea.

The next moment, a blurred phantom slowly condensed from Lu Daosheng.

Seeing the movement, Yan Lingyun opened her eyes and looked at the phantom in front of Lu Daosheng in confusion.

I saw that the phantom gradually changed its form and finally turned into a human form.

As the phantom gradually condensed, a handsome young man appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

"Daosheng, are you?"

Lu Daosheng responded with a smile: "This is a clone I made. How about it? You're handsome."

"Cut?"

"Yes, Lu Xue is still a little too young now. I decided to go and secretly guide her in person, and then leave after she can really stand alone."

After hearing Lu Daosheng's decision, Yan Lingyun did not refute.

This is indeed the best.

As Lu Daosheng slowly closed his eyes.

The young man in front of him opened his eyes.

"Lingyun, how do you feel?"

The young man is naturally Lu Daosheng. At this moment, Lu Daosheng's main consciousness has entered the clone he created.

Looking at the young man in front of him, Yan Lingyun nodded and said, "Xiaoxue must not be able to see it."

The two looked at each other and then showed a somewhat bad smile.

"Lingyun, then I'll go."

"Okay, be careful."

Then, Lu Daosheng turned into a meteor and flew straight towards the direction of the fairy world.
